chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: All three one-cost cards, spending exactly 3 energy: All Streams Flow to the Sea into Sludge Spinner for 9 (Charge already counted), Water's Edge into it for 6, then Coral Guard for 5 Block. That is 15 damage, taking the Spinner from 37 to 22, and the telegraphed 8-damage attack lands into 5 Block so I take 3 and end at 45/70. There is no lethal available this turn at any energy split, so the turn is about maximizing damage per energy while blunting a known hit, and the three cheap cards do both with nothing left over.
q2_other_line_considered: Rally the Isles for 2, then one one-cost with the last energy. I weighed it as the setup line: Muster 2 turns two of the remaining hand cards into random Inazuma Companions and the +1 Charge nudges the Charge pool. Against a 37 HP enemy that will take roughly three turns to chew through, paying tempo for a possibly better hand is a real thought. I dropped it because Rally itself deals nothing and blocks nothing, it would cost me at least 6 known damage plus either the 5 Block or the other attack, the +1 Charge does nothing here since All Streams reads Charge at one point per two and 8 to 9 is not a step, and Muster's picks are the game's random roll, so I would be trading guaranteed value for an unknown against an enemy that is already hitting me.
q3_what_it_gave_up: The Muster entirely. Two cards I would have transformed stay whatever they are, I do not see what companions the roll would have offered, and the Charge does not advance. If this fight runs long, the line I skipped is the one that could have compounded, and I spent the turn on flat rate instead. I also emptied my hand of all three cheap cards, so whatever I draw into next turn is unsupported by anything held back.
q4_different_intent: Yes. If the Spinner had telegraphed nothing, a buff, or an attack small enough to shrug off, Coral Guard's 5 Block would be wasted and I would strongly consider Rally the Isles plus All Streams Flow to the Sea, taking the free window to Muster and set up rather than spending energy on unneeded Block. A much larger telegraphed hit would not have changed anything, since 5 Block plus two attacks is already the most I can do about it with this hand and I cannot outrace a 37 HP enemy by dropping the block.
